async def _synthesize_and_save_daily_forecast(user_id: int, profile: dict, profile_hash: str, target_date: date, sifu_mode: bool, language: str) -> DailyForecastRecord:
    from src2.engine.bazi_cache import get_or_fetch_classical_text
    from src2.engine.context_template import ANNUAL_PILLAR
    from src2.interfaces.telegram.chronomancer.coordinator import handle_ask_get_monthly_str, handle_ask_get_user_state, session_to_chart_profile
    from src2.interfaces.telegram.session import get_session
    from .agents import SCORE_LEGEND, DailyDeps, compute_shen_sha_context, compute_structural_map, format_day_scores, get_daily_orchestrator
    date_str = target_date.isoformat()
    day_pillar, scored = _score_day_for_profile(profile, target_date)
    dp_stem, dp_branch = _extract_stem_branch(day_pillar)
    alias = profile.get('alias') or 'User'
    session = get_session(user_id)
    chart_profile = session_to_chart_profile(session) if session and session.profile else None
    target_dates = [target_date]
    structural_map = compute_structural_map(profile, target_dates, ANNUAL_PILLAR) if chart_profile else ''
    clashed_branches_map = {}
    shen_sha_context = compute_shen_sha_context(profile, target_dates, ANNUAL_PILLAR, clashed_branches_map) if chart_profile else ''
    day_scores = format_day_scores(scored)
    state_task = handle_ask_get_user_state(user_id)
    rag_keywords = _get_daily_rag_keywords(day_pillar, dp_stem, dp_branch)
    trigger_labels = _extract_trigger_labels(scored)
    trigger_keywords = _get_trigger_rag_keywords(trigger_labels)
    all_rag_keywords = rag_keywords + trigger_keywords
    rag_task = get_or_fetch_classical_text(all_rag_keywords)
    monthly_task = handle_ask_get_monthly_str(user_id, target_date, alias)
    user_state, rag_context, monthly_context_str = await asyncio.gather(state_task, rag_task, monthly_task)
    monthly_context_str = monthly_context_str or ''
    trigger_context = _build_trigger_context(trigger_labels, rag_context)
    deps = DailyDeps(user_id=user_id, target_dates=target_dates, alias=alias, sifu_mode=sifu_mode, user_state=user_state, rag_context=rag_context, trigger_context=trigger_context, structural_map=structural_map, shen_sha_context=shen_sha_context, day_scores=day_scores, monthly_context=monthly_context_str, score_legend=SCORE_LEGEND)
    orchestrator = get_daily_orchestrator()
    result = await orchestrator.run("Generate today's comprehensive daily Bazi forecast.", deps=deps)
    synthesis = await _simplify_synthesis_if_needed(result.output, sifu_mode, alias, scored, language)
    pillar_info = scored.get('pillar', {})
    stem = pillar_info.get('stem', dp_stem)
    branch = pillar_info.get('branch', dp_branch)
    activities = scored.get('activities', {})
    activities = DailyActivities.model_validate(activities) if isinstance(activities, dict) else activities
    events = scored.get('events', [])
    hourly_scores = scored.get('hourly_scores', {})
    db.save_daily_forecast(user_id=user_id, profile_hash=profile_hash, date=date_str, stem=dp_stem, branch=dp_branch, activities=activities, events=events, hourly_scores=hourly_scores, narrative=synthesis, language=language)
    return DailyForecastRecord(user_id=user_id, profile_hash=profile_hash, date=target_date, stem=stem, branch=branch, activities=activities, events=events, hourly_scores=hourly_scores, narrative=synthesis, synthesis=synthesis)
